تتحاشوا (form VI)
# تَتَحَاشَوْا (tataḥāšaw) /ta.ta.ħaː.ʃaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
# تُتَحَاشَوْا (tutaḥāšaw) /tu.ta.ħaː.ʃaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَحَاشَى (taḥāšā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
